newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - NatWest cuts Palmer EBITDA view.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - NatWest cuts Palmer EBITDA view.

text.p: -- NatWest Securities said Friday it lowered estimates for Palmer Wireless Inc's fourth quarter EBITDA by five percent to about $16 to $17 million.
-- NatWest said it expects the company's fourth quarter subscriber additions will fall about 7,000 to 11,000 below original expectations of 24,000.
-- NatWest reiterated its rating of accumulate on the stock.
-- Late on Thursday, Palmer said it expects fourth quarter subscriber growth and operating cash flow to fall below Wall Street expectations.
-- Palmer's stock fell 4-3/8 to 12-1/8 on Friday.
